A RESOLUTION
Recognizing and commending Rashan Ali Smith; and for other purposes.1
WHEREAS, with a passion for sports and entertainment, Rashan Ali Smith, born in Atlanta,2
Georgia, and raised in Decatur, has established herself as a revered multimedia personality;3
and4
WHEREAS, an honor graduate of Florida A&M University, she has had candid perspective5
on local Atlanta radio for nearly 15 years on HOT 107.9, V-103 and Streetz 94.5, helping to6
propel those stations' ratings to top five in the market; and7
WHEREAS, lending her talents to sports television, she worked a s a sports anchor for8
Headlines News and CNN as well as a sideline reporter for CBS Sports Network, covering9
college football and basketball for four seasons; and10
WHEREAS, Rashan delivered her unique and personable perspective as one of four co-hosts11
on the nationally syndicated daily talk show, Sister Circle Live on TV One for three seasons;12
and13

WHEREAS, she currently hosts "The Cool Soror Podcast," a show in which she created to14
highlight outstanding women and men in Black Greek Lettered Organizations; and15
WHEREAS, her passion and purpose are deeply tied to the community; she is the founder16
of Sporty Girls, Inc., a non-profit organization that encourages the development of life and17
academic skills in girls ages 8-18 through participation in golf, tennis, soccer, swimming, and18
lacrosse; and 19
WHEREAS, since its inception in 2006, Sporty Girls, Inc., has served nearly 2,000 girls in20
the Metro Atlanta area; and21
WHEREAS, Rashan is planning to relaunch Sporty Girls, Inc., in 2025; and22
WHEREAS, Rashan has also published and released a vibrant children’s book called "Piper23
Sky’s Pink Popsicle Shoes," based on the likeness of her own daughters as it follows the lead24
character, Piper Sky, and her quest to help her friends find their own magic; and25
WHEREAS, Rashan is a proud member of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority , Inc., where she26
serves internationally on the honorary and awards committee; and 27
WHEREAS, she currently has a recurring role on a top-rated show  under the Tyler Perry28
print on BET+; and29
WHEREAS, she has been married to Brian Smith for 22 years and they have two daughters;30
Bailey, a freshman at Howard University, and Carter, a 9th grader; and31
WHEREAS, Rashan lives by the motto, “Giving is the rent we pay for living."32

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES that33
the members of this body recognize and commend Rashan Ali Smith and extend sincere best34
wishes for her continued health, happiness, and success. 35
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Clerk of the House of Representatives is authorized36
and directed to make an appropriate copy of this resolution ava ilable for distribution to37
